summary: AI technology is being applied to faecal egg counting to help identify barber's pole worm within minutes, supporting parasite control amid ongoing drench resistance on pastoral farms.

New Zealand’s sheep industry has changed dramatically over the past few decades. summary: Massey University is surveying New Zealand sheep farmers on lamb survival, which remains a key driver of farm performance and profitability amid strong lamb prices and increased multiple-bearing ewes.
